name: Image Vision Pattern
description: AI image analysis with vision capability (supports PDF too)
explanation:
Pattern for image/PDF analysis using AI vision.

Key settings:
- imageInput: true (enables image upload)
- pdfInput: true (enables PDF upload)
- model: 'gpt-4o' (vision-capable model required)
- Can use json output for structured extraction

Use cases:
- Receipt data extraction
- Invoice processing
- Document digitization
- Image content analysis

For structured output, set outputFormat: 'json' with schema.
